acquisition_method: The most intense precursor ions (intensity ≥ 5.0 × 103) with charge states 3–8 and monoisotopic peak determination set to ‘peptide’ were selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
alkylation_reagent: In short, samples were dried (Eppendorf, Concentrator plus), resuspended in 8 M urea, reduced, alkylated and digested with trypsin (Promega).
cleavage_agent: In short, samples were dried (Eppendorf, Concentrator plus), resuspended in 8 M urea, reduced, alkylated and digested with trypsin (Promega).
collision_energy: The most intense precursor ions (intensity ≥ 5.0 × 103) with charge states 3–8 and monoisotopic peak determination set to ‘peptide’ were selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
enrichment_method: Crosslinked peptides were enriched by size exclusion chromatography (SEC) using an ÄKTAmicro chromatography system (GE Healthcare) equipped with a Superdex Peptide 3.2/30 column (column volume, 2.4 ml).
fragmentation_method: The most intense precursor ions (intensity ≥ 5.0 × 103) with charge states 3–8 and monoisotopic peak determination set to ‘peptide’ were selected for MS/MS fragmentation by CID at 35% collision energy in a data-dependent mode.
instrument: LC–MS/MS analysis was carried out on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron).
labeling: After TEV cleavage, the eluate from 2 L of culture was incubated with purified Drg1 (150 µg) in the presence of 1 mM ATPγS for 30 minutes on a rotator at room temperature. Afterwards, one-third of the sample was supplemented with 1.5 mM isotopically labeled crosslinking reagent A (disuccinimidyl suberate, DSS-d0/DSS-d12, Creative molecules) and one-third with 1.5 mM isotopically labeled Crosslinker reagent B (bis(sulfosuccinimidyl)suberate, BS3-d0/BS3-d12, Sigma).
mass_analyzer: LC–MS/MS analysis was carried out on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron).
